title: Integral Matrices of Fixed Rank over Number Fields: Lean formalization
summary: A Lean formalization of the fixed-rank asymptotic count for integral matrices over a number field and the convergence of moments of lifts of algebraic codes. The public results preserve the submission PDF's main scale, error terms, echelon-integral limit, and denominator normalization. The intermediate-rank height-counting input attributed to Schmidt is an explicit hypothesis; it is not silently assumed as an axiom.
